title: On Reciting the whole poem from memory
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：recite　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 recite 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1990 the builder ① recited the whole poem from memory in the rain, and every assistant in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the builder ② recites the whole poem from memory without complaint without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ recite the whole poem from memory at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ recited the whole poem from memory before — a line in the plan for October 1984 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Reciting the whole poem from memory in the rain, the builder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ recite the names one after another without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Recite the names one after another at once and never mention it again.

By 1997 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the plan, and a new assistant from the next site ⑧ recites the names one after another in the rain every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the wall, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ recited the whole poem from memory again when nobody else would.

⑩ To recite the whole poem from memory, my mother said in 2002, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the site remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the site forgets, somebody recites the whole poem from memory without complaint again and somebody must recite the whole poem from memory in the rain all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 背诵（一般过去式 recited the whole poem from memory：1990 年施工员头一回这样做，淋着雨）
B. v. 背诵（一般现在 recites the whole poem from memory：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 背诵（不定式 to recite the whole poem from memory：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 背诵（过去完成时 had recited the whole poem from memory：1984 年十月的施工图上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 背诵（动名词 reciting the whole poem from memory 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 逐个数出（recite the names one after another：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去逐个数出把那些名字一个接一个说出）
G. v. 逐个数出（recite the names one after another：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 背诵（后段两处：新来的帮工照例 recites the names one after another，而母亲又一次 recited the whole poem from memory）

answers.why: recite 意为“背诵”，1990 年施工员淋着雨背诵凭记忆背出整首诗，那是工地里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 recited。
recite 意为“背诵”，自那以后施工员毫无怨言地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 recites。
recite 意为“背诵”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯背诵凭记忆背出整首诗”，此处为不定式 to recite the whole poem from memory。
recite 意为“背诵”，施工图里 十月 那行字说明早在 1997 年之前就有人背诵过，故用过去完成时 had recited。
recite 意为“背诵”，施工员说“背诵凭记忆背出整首诗这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 reciting the whole poem from memory 作主语。
recite 意为“逐个数出”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去逐个数出把那些名字一个接一个说出”，should ever 之后用原形 recite the names one after another。
recite 意为“逐个数出”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻逐个数出把那些名字一个接一个说出（recite the names one after another at once），以后再也不要提起。
recite 意为“背诵”，新来的帮工每个月份都照例逐个数出把那些名字一个接一个说出，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 recites。
recite 意为“背诵”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次淋着雨背诵凭记忆背出整首诗，用一般过去式 recited 叙述。
recite 意为“背诵”，结尾那句是母亲 2002 年的话：要背诵凭记忆背出整首诗，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和工地记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 recite 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1990 the builder recited the whole poem from memory in the rain, and nobody in the site forgot it.
Even now the builder recites the whole poem from memory without complaint whenever the site asks.
Reciting the whole poem from memory in the rain, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever recite the names one after another without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new assistant from the next site recites the names one after another in the rain every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother recited the whole poem from memory again, and the site remembered that half.
